propositions: Markdown source in Jira Cloud descriptions and comments must encode as structured ADF paragraphs instead of plain-text literals during round-trip reconciliation
Markdown in Jira Data Center descriptions and comments must render as native Jira wiki markup through a pandoc-based segmenting renderer with fallback and timeout bounds
Echo-safety mechanism using per-binding baselines, change-gated rich_sha, and three-way LLM comparison must suppress redundant updates and flag concurrent edits without data loss
Jira-native constructs (panels, mentions, dates) must survive origin-gated outbound normalization when authored remotely and reconciled locally
Comment synchronization must use an append-only ID map to route newly created comments bidirectionally through the same rich-text codec as descriptions, without edit or delete
Live DC Docker harness must verify rendered HTML output through expand=renderedFields and prove idempotence (second reconcile pass adds zero body updates)
